what_changed: Added explicit trusted route-policy manifest activation while preserving static no-manifest installation.
Added one-snapshot preferred/fallback resolution for the 12 required Codex agents, canonical non-route contract validation, and one optional helper decision.
Extended canonical materialization to render selected model and effort while binding original source bytes and unchanged non-route fields.

Added strict global override, exact-byte managed-helper removal, caller-provenance rejection, preservation, bounded probes, complete-plan-before-write apply, exact installed-state binding, concurrent-edit refusal, and rollback recovery evidence.
Added deterministic fake-home fixtures/tests, Codex install documentation, generated payload mirrors, installed-cache proofs, runner trust metadata, and docs references.
why: Provide the reusable resolver/materializer/installer framework required before downstream G56R-007 through G56R-010 can qualify production route policies.
non_goals: No production route qualification or default route-policy activation.
No live model calls or real-user-home acceptance writes.
No per-agent override map or arbitrary effort override map.
No downstream cohort assignment or G56R-011 final roster composition.
review_order: Manifest and response contracts plus fixture corpus.
Canonical materializer route rendering and proof fields.
Installer manifest trust and single-snapshot resolution.
Strict override and optional-helper decision/ownership behavior.
Apply planning, verification, rollback, and recovery evidence.
Focused tests, generated payload/trust artifacts, and docs.

artifact-author, sweep-analyst, sweep-classifier, consensus-synthesizer, and gate-validator remain reconciliation inputs without cohort assignment here.
No production route policy is qualified or enabled by default.
The authored implementation exceeds the planning estimate and requires the mandatory post reviewability decision.

rollback_or_feature_flag.activation: Route-aware behavior activates only when route_policy_manifest is explicitly supplied and validated.
rollback_or_feature_flag.fallback: Omitting route_policy_manifest retains the prior static 13-file installer behavior and response shape.
rollback_or_feature_flag.apply_recovery: Route-aware apply captures prior bytes, modes, and file identities; it refuses concurrent-edit overwrite and reports restored or unrestored recovery evidence with restart guidance.
rollback_or_feature_flag.helper_removal: Caller-asserted provenance is not trusted; removal requires exact bytes rendered from the trusted current helper source and manifest.
